xwikidoc.title: Migration from 1.x
xwikidoc.content:
{{velocity}} ## The migration converts every 1.x change document of the wiki and saves it, and the conversion cannot be undone: ## it removes the 1.x object from the page it converts. Its query is not restricted to the ReleaseNotes space, so ## administering the wiki is what it takes to run it. The check gates the listing as well as the conversion: a user ## who may not run the migration has no use for the list of the pages it would touch, and hiding the action while ## still answering the request that performs it would not keep that request from performing it. ## The check is in the page content, so the document also enforces wiki_admin as a required right: that is ## what refuses edit on this page to anyone who does not already hold the right the check tests for. #set ($hasWikiAdmin = $services.security.authorization.hasAccess('admin', $doc.documentReference.wikiReference)) #if (!$hasWikiAdmin) {{error}}{{translation key="releasenotes.migration.notAllowed"/}}{{/error}} #else ## Find all pages having a v1.x ReleaseNotes.Code.ChangesClass #set ($xwql = "from doc.object(ReleaseNotes.Code.ChangesClass) as changes") ## The migration writes to every 1.x change document, so it only runs on a request carrying a valid ## form token; a request without one falls through to the unconfirmed state and changes nothing. #set ($migrate = ($request.confirm == '1' && $services.csrf.isTokenValid($request.getParameter('form_token')))) #if (!$migrate) {{translation key="releasenotes.migration.pending"/}} #else {{translation key="releasenotes.migration.migrated"/}} #end #foreach ($item in $services.query.xwql($xwql).execute()) ## The page name is chosen by whoever created the page, and it is emitted into both parts of a link, so it is ## escaped: a name holding "]]" would otherwise close the link and have the rest of it parsed as wiki syntax. The ## label is escaped twice, since the link parser removes one level of escaping before it parses the label as wiki ## syntax, while the reference is used as it is once that level is removed. #set ($escapedItem = $services.rendering.escape($item, 'xwiki/2.1')) #set ($escapedItemLabel = $services.rendering.escape($escapedItem, 'xwiki/2.1')) #if ($migrate) #set ($itemDoc = $xwiki.getDocument($item)) ## Add a ReleaseNotes.Code.EntryClass #set ($newEntryObject = $itemDoc.newObject("ReleaseNotes.Code.EntryClass")) ## Add a ReleaseNotes.Code.Change.ChangeClass #set ($newChangeObject = $itemDoc.newObject("ReleaseNotes.Code.Change.ChangeClass")) ## Copy data from ReleaseNotes.Code.ChangesClass into the 2 new objects #set ($oldChangeObject = $itemDoc.getObject("ReleaseNotes.Code.ChangesClass")) #set ($discard = $newEntryObject.set('version', $oldChangeObject.getValue('version'))) #set ($discard = $newEntryObject.set('product', $oldChangeObject.getValue('product'))) #set ($discard = $newEntryObject.set('type', 'Change')) #set ($discard = $newChangeObject.set('summary', $oldChangeObject.getValue('summary'))) #set ($discard = $newChangeObject.set('audience', $oldChangeObject.getValue('audience'))) #set ($discard = $newChangeObject.set('importance', $oldChangeObject.getValue('importance'))) #set ($discard = $newChangeObject.set('description', $oldChangeObject.getValue('description'))) #set ($discard = $newChangeObject.set('category', $oldChangeObject.getValue('category'))) #set ($discard = $newChangeObject.set('title', $oldChangeObject.getValue('title'))) #set ($discard = $newChangeObject.set('screenshots', $oldChangeObject.getValue('screenshots'))) ## Remove the old ReleaseNotes.Code.ChangesClass xobject #set ($discard = $itemDoc.removeObject($oldChangeObject)) ## Save the changes #set ($discard = $itemDoc.save('Migrated from v1.x format to v2.0', true)) * [[$escapedItemLabel>>$escapedItem]] #else * [[$escapedItemLabel>>$escapedItem]] #end #end
#if (!$migrate) [[{{translation key="releasenotes.migration.start"/}}>>||queryString="confirm=1&form_token=$escapetool.url($services.csrf.token)"]] #end #end {{/velocity}}
